paths.postgres: ADR 0003: only packages/db may use the raw database client. Use withTenant() from @helpos/db.
paths.drizzle-orm/postgres-js: ADR 0003: only packages/db may use the raw database client. Use withTenant() from @helpos/db.
paths.drizzle-orm: Import query helpers (eq, sql, ...) from @helpos/db. A second drizzle-orm copy breaks its types.
paths.pg-boss: Use enqueue() and createJobRunner() from @helpos/db, so jobs stay tenant-scoped.

@hono/zod-openapi.message: Define API routes with apiRoute() from apps/server/src/auth/access.ts: it requires `access` (the scopes a caller needs) and enforces it before the handler runs.

pino.message: Create loggers with createLogger() from apps/server/src/logger.ts: it redacts secrets and logs errors as their summary, never their message. Import only the Logger type from pino.
